title: Marin Docs guide configuration
description: The configuration beside a guide's Markdown (guides/<slug>/data/guide.json). The Markdown holds the words: one H2 is one page, an H3 is a section of that page, and lists, numbered steps, tables and checklists keep their shape. This file names what is structured: pages and their order, an optional lifecycle with a landing page for each step, content limits, key terms and links. scripts/build-guide.js reads it and builds the pages, a JSON-LD block in each page and structured-data.json.

slug.description: The folder name under guides/ and the guide's address.

name.description: The guide's name, shown as the home page title and in every breadcrumb.

audience.description: Who the guide is for, for example County of Marin staff.

baseUrl.description: The guide's public address, with no trailing slash. Used in the JSON-LD.

source.description: The Markdown file, relative to the data folder (../source/playbook.md).

indexPage.description: The H2 in the Markdown that is the guide's home page. Default: the first H2.

titles.description: Rename a page without changing the Markdown: { "H2 text": "Page name" }.

split.description: Turn sections (H3) of a page into pages of their own.

groups.description: The left menu: groups of page titles, in reading order. Every page must be in one group.

pages.description: Settings for a page, keyed by its slug (index for the home page).

specs.description: Content limits: lengths and formats, each tied to the sentence that states it.

terms.description: Key terms for the structured data, each defined by a sentence in the Markdown.

links.description: Named links, listed on pages that ask for them (pages.<slug>.links) and on link pages.

linkPages.description: Pages of named links, such as Links or Learn. Each must be in a group. Without this, one Links page lists every named link.

phase.description: Heading of the list on a lifecycle landing page. Default: In this phase.

limits.description: Heading of the limits table on a page. Default: Limits.

training.description: Label on a training example. Default: Training example.

links.description: Heading of a page's links section. Default: Links.

titledPage.description: A page the generator makes (content limits, links): its title, which must be in a group, and its description.

links.description: Keys of named links, in order.

linkPage.description: A page the generator makes from named links: its slug, its title (which must be in a group), its description and the links it lists.

home.description: The home page: sections of linked pages, each with the first sentence of every page. Without this, the home page lists the groups.

lifecycle.description: List the lifecycle steps, each with the sentence for the step.

source.description: The H3 on the home page whose paragraphs open this section.

lifecycle.description: An ordered process. Each step gets a landing page (its sentence and the pages of that phase) and a place in the numbered bar above every page of the process.

label.description: Name of the bar for assistive technology, for example Engagement lifecycle.

source.description: The H2 that holds the numbered list of steps, each "**Name.** sentence".

stage.description: The step's name, as written in the numbered list.

page.description: The slug of the step's landing page.

stage.description: The lifecycle step this page belongs to.

lifecycle.description: Show the numbered bar with no step marked.

links.description: Keys of links to list on the page.

specs.description: Ids of content limits to show on the page.

training.description: Label the page a training example, using the sentence that begins "*These examples".

spec.description: Either a range (min and max, or just max, with a unit) or a plain value.

value.description: A limit that is not a number, for example MP4.

evidence.description: Text that must appear in the Markdown. The build stops if it does not.

description.description: A sentence that appears in the Markdown.

page.description: The slug of the page that defines it.
